disclaimer: This is a maintenance-priority aid based on image classification, not a remaining-useful-life or replacement decision. Confirm abnormal findings through qualified site inspection.

No-Anomaly.recommended_action: No obvious thermal anomaly was identified. Continue routine monitoring and scheduled inspection.

Cell.recommended_action: Inspect the affected cell area and compare electrical performance before deciding whether repair or replacement is required.

Cell-Multi.recommended_action: Arrange a prompt professional inspection of the multiple affected cell areas and verify module and string electrical performance.

Cracking.recommended_action: Perform visual and electrical inspection. Base any replacement decision on confirmed damage, safety risk, and measured performance loss.

Diode.recommended_action: Have qualified personnel inspect the bypass diode, wiring, connectors, and associated module or string.

Diode-Multi.recommended_action: Prioritise professional electrical inspection of the bypass diodes and associated module or string before continued operation.

Hot-Spot.recommended_action: Arrange prompt thermographic and electrical inspection, checking for shading, soiling, cell damage, mismatch, and connection faults.

Hot-Spot-Multi.recommended_action: Prioritise professional thermographic and electrical inspection of all highlighted regions and assess whether the module should be isolated.

Offline-Module.recommended_action: Promptly check module and string operating status, connectors, wiring, inverter input, and monitoring communication.

Shadowing.recommended_action: Identify whether the shadow is temporary or avoidable, remove the cause where safe, and repeat the inspection under suitable conditions.

Soiling.recommended_action: Inspect for dust, bird droppings, or debris; clean according to the site procedure and repeat the inspection.

Vegetation.recommended_action: Inspect for vegetation obstruction, manage it safely according to the site procedure, and repeat the inspection.
